messages.text:
You are queued: the iPhone is yours as soon as the first half of the running phone test ends, about 10:12Z.
- Right now the heat test (P-129) is mid-run on the phone; no phone step may start during it.
- It runs in two halves; your Try-it goes between them, before the second half.
- I will post one step in Your steps with the A and B links for the end-of-page menu proposal (PR-023 rev 5) on the iPhone.
- Keep Xcode's Serious condition on; the test checks the heat again after you.
What you need to do: nothing yet; start the step when it appears (about 10:12Z).

The iPhone is yours now: your step is posted in Your steps as C-067 (try the end-of-page menu proposal, A vs B).
- The first half of the heat test (P-129) finished early, at 10:04Z, so you need not wait for 10:12Z.
- The second half starts after you press Done.
What you need to do: open C-067, try A and B on the iPhone, press Done, then give your verdict on the Proposals page.
Which thermal state at this time ? Is it critical ?

Not critical: the phone was at Serious at the last read, 10:03:48Z, 3 min before your question.
- That level is Xcode's heat mode (Serious), set on purpose; the phone itself is not that hot.
- Battery 38.9 °C at the last read, up from 37.0 °C at 09:58Z. Our tests stop at 44 °C or Critical.

- The heat test reads it again when its second half starts, after your Done.
What you need to do: nothing; try A and B as planned.

Thanks: your accept of the end-of-page menu change (PR-023, the 7d version) is recorded (10:15Z).
